stemMd: What is the complete real solution set of $3x+2<2x-5$?
explanationMd: Subtract 2x and subtract 2 from both sides to obtain x<−7. Only addition and subtraction were used, so the direction stays the same.

distractorRationale.e: Subtracting x terms does not reverse the inequality here.
distractorRationale.b: That gives equality, excluded by the strict inequality.
distractorRationale.d: Both the sign and direction are incorrect.
distractorRationale.a: The constant difference is negative seven.
